title: Welcome email after sign-up
prompt: New users sign up with POST /signup (public), which takes { email, name }, creates a member user and answers 201 with { id, email, name }. After the user is created, send them a welcome email from a background job named "send-welcome" whose input is { userId } (a uuid), not during the request. Use Inferlo's built-in email support with SMTP: add a required SMTP_URL setting to src/config.ts (it holds the SMTP password, so it is a secret), create the mailer in src/mail.ts with the sender "Acme <no-reply@acme.dev>" and a "welcome" template whose subject is "Welcome to Acme, {{name}}" and which has a plain-text and an HTML body that greet the user by name, and register the mailer and the job in src/app.ts. Put the route in src/routes/signup.ts.
